text: Resolved via fmrireg #226 at 60f8430: explicit nonnegative weights are honored by joint IID OLS and unsupported paths fail closed. Topofmri retired the one-hot spike workaround without changing its retained-row estimand. Exact Trillium qualification against independent QR passed (beta/contrast max relative error below 1.84e-12); explicit weights and legacy spikes agree on task coefficients within 6.36e-12 and contrasts within 8.29e-12. The three real affected fits pass independent audits at 1.38e-13 to 8.60e-13. GitHub issue #226 is closed.
